secondDiagnosticProtocol.interpretation: Preserve native Promise identity but acknowledge added reactions and profiling overhead. Overlapping/nested spans are not additive; sampled stack presence is not exact CPU time or proof of a native wait. Align only through recorded hrtime activation brackets. Overrun, truncation, errors and drops are explicit incomplete evidence.
